highlights: Yesido KM25 1.3 inch 1080P Ultra-clear Night Vision Video Recorder
1. 1.3-inch ultra-clear display screen, view playback video at any time, and view on-site at the first time.
2. Large aperture ultra-clear glass lens, support H.264 encoded video.
3. Adopt smart sensor, have excellent imaging effect in low light environment, 1080P clear recording picture.

4. Infrared night vision produces clear images at night or in low light conditions, and captures the Huawei radiation emitted by objects through infrared thermal imaging technology, which can achieve effective monitoring even in completely dark environments.
5. Adopt gravity sensing intelligent anti-shake algorithm, which can effectively offset the camera''s shaking in all directions, and the picture is always stable and clear.
6. One-click to turn on the night vision light. Independent recording and recording buttons, you can complete recording and recording with one click in an emergency.
7. Support TF card expansion to 128G, classic10 and above TF cards, compatible and stable.
8. The 180-degree rotating camera can easily shoot objects at different angles, and users can easily observe the screen, which improves the flexibility and convenience of shooting.
9. When the battery is low, it will automatically save the files and then shut down to prevent the loss of files due to low battery. It is safe and reliable.
10. The device can be connected to the computer USB and viewed at any time.
